chunks: I was informed by one who raised it to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Concerning His, Mighty and Majestic, saying:
But he did not attempt the steep ascent. And what will make you know what the steep ascent is? It is the freeing of a slave.
By His saying, “the freeing of a slave,” He means the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.
For that is the freeing of a slave.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn; title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْعَقَبَةَ: the steep ascent; a difficult path whose meaning is being explained in the report
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; glorification of Allah
key_terms.فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ: freeing a slave; interpreted here as spiritual liberation through wilayah
key_terms.وَلَايَةَ: wilayah; divinely sanctioned authority and allegiance

ai.seo_question: How is “فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ” interpreted in Shia hadith regarding the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report presents the verse as an instance of Qur'anic commentary in which “freeing a slave” is interpreted as the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. Its significance lies in linking spiritual liberation and salvation to rightful allegiance and authority.
